source_text.body:
Build a job-search helper agent for CV, interviews and research
After redundancy, a commenter set up a Gemini agent to help with their CV, interview prep and research, and says it helped them land a job in about three months.
·
Sep 19, 2026
Done with
GE
Gemini
What they did
After being made redundant, the commenter set up a Gemini agent as a job-search helper for CV work, interview prep, and research. They say Gemini 3.8 and its integration with email, Drive, and phone were useful, and they also used it conversationally for encouragement during the search; the post does not describe the agent’s step-by-step workflow or any human review beyond their own use.
How it went
They say they landed a job after about three months. They also mention some frustrations and annoyances with Gemini, and say they started hitting limits in other projects, but give no specific shortcoming for the job-search setup.
Worth knowing
They were on a yearly Gemini plan, and the stated job-search timeline was about three months.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
I'm looking for a job as a [role] in [industry/location] after being made redundant. Act as my job-search helper: first ask me for my current CV and background, then rewrite my CV to match [target job description], and give me 10 likely interview questions with feedback on my practice answers. Also research [3-5 target companies] and give me a one-page briefing on each. You're done when I have an updated CV, an interview prep sheet, and the company briefings.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GeminiAI/comments/1wdhd8y/am_i_the_only_one_having_a_good_experience
